# TypeTorch

> TypeTorch is a roblox-ts framework and toolchain that updates live Roblox games without restarting servers. A small Luau kernel baked into the place loads each build (a payload of ModuleScripts uploaded as a private Model asset) and hot-swaps server and client code in seconds while players stay. Code uses @typetorch/framework (modules with dependency injection, lifecycle hooks, troves, guarded networking, hot assets, an in-game dev menu); the typetorch CLI builds, uploads, approves, signs (prod) and deploys. roblox-ts only. Early: packages are not on npm yet (planned); today they come from local checkouts as packed tarballs.

Key facts for agents:
- Never handle secrets (Open Cloud keys, signing key files) and never act on Roblox (deploy, publish, keys, approve): those are user steps. Follow agents/AGENTS.md.
- Every module must be stoppable and restartable: everything in this.trove, no module-level state (persist plain data with this.ctx.persist), players via onPlayerAdded/observePlayers (replays on every swap), no RemoteEvents (createNetwork), no _G.
- The payload holds only Folders and ModuleScripts; entry points are src/server/boot.ts and src/client/boot.ts.
- The template repo decides the toolchain (package.json, tsconfig.json, default.project.json, studio.project.json).

## Get started

- [README](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/README.md): index, how it works, repositories
- [Fresh setup](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/getting-started/fresh-setup.md): tools, sibling checkouts, experience and settings, typetorch.json, API key scopes, signing keys, kernel publish, first deploy, dev branch, dev menu access, /tt, rollback
- [Migrate an existing game](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/getting-started/migrate.md): toolchain, boot modules, Flamework/Knit/singletons to modules, the swap-safety rules with before/after code, networking, UI, data, installing the kernel in a place with content, checklist, pitfalls

- [Testing in Studio](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/studio-testing.md): studio.project.json, bun run watch + bun run studio, local payload

- [Runtime API](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/runtime-api.md): TypeTorch.* identity, startInfo, onSwapOut, onUpdatePending, onBranchChanged, persist, roles, status, logs, asset
- [Networking](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/networking.md): createNetwork, guards, limits, requests
- [remote-claude](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/remote-claude.md): Claude Code prompted from a dev server; Live/Code modes, deploy approval, screenshots, Toolbox

- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/troubleshooting.md): real errors and fixes
